preparationAttempts: The initial harness did not enable the existing synthetic market opt-in; fixture use was denied. Onboarding was also completed explicitly before the counted run.

With opt-in enabled, the old helper still waited for ACK while Paper had no synthetic market evidence; public risk refused QUOTE_FRESHNESS, MARKET_SESSION, CORPORATE_ACTION_COVERAGE, HISTORICAL_ADJUSTMENT and INSTRUMENT_RULES. Integration/test-only synthetic context selection now includes the exact Alpaca/PAPER account/environment. Normal builds retain the ordinary path.

Later preparations reached ACK but order-book refresh correctly refused PROVIDER_REVIEW_REQUIRED after reload reset credentials to UNCHECKED. The helper now uses the saved connection and explicitly refreshes it before reading orders.

The old final-health expectation assumed DEGRADED reconciliation after reload; the counted assertion follows the startup STALE reconciliation, UNVERIFIED authentication and preserved DEGRADED private stream.
The old zero-alert assertion incorrectly rejected the persisted STREAM_DISCONNECTED recovery surface after disconnect; it now asserts that exact recovery state.
An added keyboard assertion initially used an absent private data-safe-default attribute. It now identifies the public Keep reviewing button by role/name.
Preparatory passes at 16:19:36Z and 16:20:53.309Z preceded the final keyboard/action-geometry and explicit command-allowlist checks; only the current final result is counted.
